hypothesis: get_trip_expenses queries expenses for arbitrary trip_id without checking check_trip_access membership and lacks HTTPException re-raise before the generic 500 handler.
update_item uses .single() which throws before checking empty results and catches HTTPException 404 inside except Exception, turning clean 404 responses into 500 errors leaking database strings.
reorder_items leaves results undefined when request.items is empty (causing UnboundLocalError) and compares len(db_items) to un-deduplicated item_ids without chunked .in_() queries.

create_manual_trip assumes count_res.count is always int (failing on mock objects), lacks empty insert guard, lacks compensating delete when trip_members insert fails, masks HTTPException 403 as 500, and lacks Idempotency-Key caching.
save_itinerary leaves orphaned itineraries and trip_members rows if itinerary_items insertion fails without compensating cleanup, uses naive datetime.now(), and lacks Idempotency-Key deduplication.

update_day_data and update_trip_location perform unlocked read-modify-write updates on itineraries.content JSONB, and update_trip_location queries itineraries before membership verification using .single() without re-raising HTTPException.
delete_day lacks per-trip async locking, uses .single(), issues N+1 individual row updates on itinerary_items shifts, and catches HTTPException 403/404 inside except Exception.
update_trip_dates lacks per-trip locking, uses .single(), runs unguarded datetime.strptime returning 500 on malformed dates, and performs N+1 item updates/deletes on day shortening.
update_expense raises HTTPException 404 inside try without except HTTPException: raise, turning 404 responses into 500 errors exposing internal database exception messages.
add_expense lacks Idempotency-Key header deduplication for offline queue replay and returns raw exception text in HTTP 500 responses.

generate_day_review lacks caller authentication and trip membership verification before reading itinerary items or writing itineraries.content, ignores locale, uses unlocked RMW with .single(), and masks HTTPException 404 as 500.
parse_markdown decodes image_base64 without validate=True or binascii.Error handling, treats json.JSONDecodeError as HTTP 500 leaking raw messages, and omits bilingual instruction support.
global_exception_handler returns raw str(exc), error_type, request path, and stack traceback lines directly in HTTP 500 response bodies.

stream_chat_generator references time_data without initialization on repeated get_world_time calls (UnboundLocalError), awaits fetch_jina_reader without explicit timeout bounds, and hardcodes Chinese progress thoughts.
_client_cache stores distinct API key clients in an unbounded dict without LRU eviction, while async model invocations omit asyncio.wait_for timeout guards.
get_donation_progress uses .single() which raises on empty rows instead of limit(1) handling and calls naive datetime.now().

getInitialOfficialLanguage falls back to sessionStorage when URL specifies unsupported ?lang= values instead of resetting to zh, and uses useState plus popstate effect rather than useSyncExternalStore.

TypewriterHeading calls setState conditionally during render instead of isolating typing state behind a key-reset inner component.
Legal terms page renders only Traditional Chinese copy even when OfficialLanguageContext active language is English.
AiImportTripWizard suppresses exhaustive-deps for handleFileSelected inside paste useEffect and omits locale when invoking aiApi.parseMarkdown.
EditableDailyAIReview omits client lang when calling tripsApi.generateAIReview and renders hardcoded Chinese loading label.
Cover image preview DialogContent renders DialogTitle inside VisuallyHidden without a matching DialogDescription.

offlineFetch only queues mutations when navigator.onLine is false, dropping failed mutating requests during Lie-Fi stalls and omitting stable Idempotency-Key headers across live and replayed requests.
